import base64
import allure
import pytest

@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def business_context():
    with allure.step('Prepare synthetic business context'):
        allure.attach('synthetic-development-fixture', 'Source', allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
    yield

@pytest.mark.parametrize('method', ['card', 'cash'])
def test_payment(method):
    with allure.step('Submit payment'):
        assert method in {'card', 'cash'}

def test_identity_required():
    with allure.step('Validate identity'):
        allure.attach(base64.b64decode('iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAQAAAC1HAwCAAAAC0lEQVR42mP8/x8AAwMCAO+jRZkAAAAASUVORK5CYII='), 'Synthetic diagnostic image', allure.attachment_type.PNG)
        assert False, 'Synthetic missing identity evidence'
